description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for end-to-end KYC (Know Your Customer) onboarding of real users through a hosted Didit verification link. Use when someone needs to perform KYC, onboard users with ID scan + selfie + face match, create a KYC workflow or a verification session for a user, add AML screening, NFC chip reading, phone or email verification, active liveness, non-document lookup or digital ID wallets to the flow, poll or receive the decision, or approve, decline or request resubmission of a session. Creates the workflow, generates the verification URL and reads the decision.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
